questions: When did the chest pain and coughing up blood start, and did the pain begin suddenly or gradually?
Do you have shortness of breath (at rest or worsening when you breathe in)?
Have you had any recent long travel or prolonged bed rest, and/or swelling or pain in one leg?
Do you have your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) or have you been told you’re low on oxygen?
Have you had any fever or recent infectious symptoms (e.g., cough with purulent sputum) in the last few days?
Did you have a recent fever measured (temperature) and what was the highest number (°C/°F)?
Do you have an oxygen saturation reading from a pulse oximeter (or have you been told you are hypoxic), and what is the number?
What is your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) measured on a pulse oximeter, if available?
Have you had a recent ECG or blood test showing your troponin level (for heart attack) or any oxygen saturation reading from a pulse oximeter?
What is your current temperature (measured) right now?
answers: The coughing up blood and the chest pain started pretty quickly, like over minutes—very sudden. The pain started at about a 5/10 speed, and it feels sharp, like a knife-stab feeling.
Yes, I’m significantly short of breath. It feels worse when I breathe in, and it’s been hard even at rest.
No recent long travel, and I haven’t been on bed rest. I also don’t have swelling or pain in one leg.
I don’t know my oxygen saturation right now, and I haven’t been told any specific SpO₂ value. But I do feel like my oxygen is low because I’m very short of breath.
Yes. I’ve had chills/shivers and a cough with colored sputum—more than usual. I’ve also had diffuse muscle pain.
I don’t have a measured temperature number, so I can’t say the highest number. I’ve had chills and shivers, but I haven’t checked it.
No, I don’t have an oxygen saturation reading or a number. I haven’t been told I’m hypoxic, but I feel very short of breath.
I don’t have a current SpO₂ reading available. I haven’t had a pulse oximeter check me right now.
No—before coming in, I haven’t had an ECG or blood test for troponin, and I don’t have any oxygen saturation reading.
I haven’t taken my temperature measured right now, so I don’t know the number. I’ve only had chills and shivers.
